title: Part 13
content_zh: The regulated verse — with eight lines, strict tonal patterns, and parallel couplets — seems impossibly constrained. Yet the Tang masters found more freedom within these eight lines than most poets find in eight hundred.
content_en: The regulated verse — with eight lines, strict tonal patterns, and parallel couplets — seems impossibly constrained. Yet the Tang masters found more freedom within these eight lines than most poets find in eight hundred.
